hot.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
hot.summary: Researchers from Meta AI developed a proactive memory agent that runs alongside an action agent, selectively injecting concise, memory-grounded reminders into the action agent's context. This mechanism effectively addresses "behavioral state decay" and consistently improves success rates on complex, long-horizon tasks like command-line execution and conversational tool use.

hot.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hot.summary: The Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) framework enhances asynchronous reinforcement learning for Large Language Models by stabilizing training and mitigating off-policy effects through single-trajectory processing and improved value model training. This approach leads to sustained performance gains and faster adaptation in complex agentic coding and reasoning tasks compared to synchronous baselines, achieving 97.3% accuracy on AIME2025.

hot.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
hot.summary: Li Auto Inc.'s Mach-Mind-4-Flash model, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with 3B activated parameters, attains performance comparable to or surpassing models in the 100B to 1T parameter range across diverse agentic tasks and reasoning benchmarks. This capability is achieved through an advanced post-training pipeline focused on reinforcement learning and distillation, rather than scaling pre-training compute.

hot.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
hot.summary: GenCeption, a generalist video perception model from Google DeepMind, repurposes a pre-trained text-to-video diffusion model into an efficient, feed-forward architecture. It achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse vision tasks like depth estimation, surface normal prediction, segmentation, and 3D keypoint estimation, exhibiting robust generalization from synthetic to real-world data and out-of-distribution categories.

hot.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
hot.summary: LingBot-VA 2.0 introduces a video-action foundation model specifically engineered for embodied robot control, utilizing a native causal architecture and a semantic visual-action tokenizer. This approach achieves a 14.0 percentage point improvement in average success rate on the RoboTwin benchmark and an end-to-end inference speedup of 6.5x, enabling real-time closed-loop control at up to 225 Hz asynchronous execution.

Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
hot.summary: A framework for Visual Pretraining (VP) is introduced, enabling large foundation models to learn directly from raw visual scientific documents without explicit text extraction. This approach consistently improves performance on scientific reasoning and multimodal benchmarks, fostering better cross-modal alignment while utilizing more compact data representations compared to text-only pretraining.

hot.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
hot.summary: Researchers at HKUST identified that Large Language Models often fail to generalize memorized facts in reasoning tasks due to a "knowledge–circuit misalignment," where new information is stored but not effectively routed to the middle computational layers crucial for multi-step reasoning. A novel "self-patching" intervention revealed this dynamic, demonstrating that strategically re-routing these representations can recover 58-75% of the potential generalization performance.

TSRouter: Dynamic Modality-Model Selection for Time Series Reasoning
hot.summary: A graph-based framework, TSROUTER, dynamically selects the most suitable input modality and large foundation model for each time series reasoning query, achieving substantial accuracy improvements up to 46% relative to baselines and demonstrating robust generalization with low latency.

hot.title: A complete ultrametric on von Neumann's incomplete tensor products
hot.summary: Andrew Lesniewski establishes a complete ultrametric structure on von Neumann's equivalence classes of C₀-sequences, which label incomplete tensor products of Hilbert spaces. This framework quantifies the "separation" or "decoherence exponent" between quantum branches in an Everettian interpretation, showing how product unitaries lead to class-dependent branch distinctions.

Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
hot.summary: LingBot-World-Infinity introduces an interactive world model capable of generating persistent, explorable virtual environments at 720p and 60 frames per second for over an hour without visual degradation. The system integrates a "Director-Pilot" agentic framework to support a versatile array of character actions and environmental interactions, advancing real-time interactive world simulation.

hot.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
hot.summary: LingBot-Video introduces an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) video foundation model tailored for embodied intelligence, enhancing physical coherence and instruction following in video generation. It integrates an MoE architecture for computational efficiency, a robot-augmented data corpus for physical grounding, and a multi-dimensional reward system for physically rational training. The model achieved an average score of 0.620 on the RBench benchmark and 40.4 on Physics-IQ Verified, outperforming other open-source models in generating physically plausible and task-oriented video content.

EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
hot.summary: Horizon Robotics and WuwenAI developed EmbodiedGen V2, a 3D world engine that generates executable, physically plausible, and interactive simulation environments for embodied AI. This system automates the creation of sim-ready 3D assets, scene composition, affordance labeling, and supports natural language-driven world editing. hot.title: Glob3R: Global Structure-from-Motion with 3D Foundation Models
hot.summary: The GLOB3R framework integrates 3D geometric foundation models with global Structure-from-Motion optimization to achieve robust and accurate 3D scene reconstruction. The method demonstrates superior camera pose accuracy and dense scene geometry recovery, yielding an average PSNR of 19.36 for novel-view synthesis on Tanks and Temples, outperforming COLMAP's 18.57.

hot.title: HyperLoRA: Generating Implicit Neural Fields in Weight Space with LoRA Parameters
What LLM Forecasters Know but Don't Say: Probing Internal Representations for Calibration and Faithfulness
hot.summary: Internal representations of large language models provide a more accurate and calibrated confidence signal for forecasts than their verbalized outputs and can identify unfaithful reasoning in their Chain-of-Thought. This methodology further enables efficient question triaging by leveraging pre-reasoning forecast commitments, improving auditability and reducing inference costs.

likes.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
likes.summary: DSpark proposes a confidence-scheduled speculative decoding framework employing semi-autoregressive generation to enhance LLM inference. This method improves draft quality for longer sequences and optimizes target model resource allocation, yielding 51% higher aggregate throughput and 60%–85% faster per-user generation speeds in production serving environments.

likes.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
likes.summary: A general-purpose verification framework leverages large language models to provide fine-grained, continuous feedback for evaluating agentic solutions, leading to performance gains across coding, robotics, and medical benchmarks. The approach also enhances reinforcement learning efficiency by providing dense reward signals.

likes.title: Vision Pretraining for Dense Spatial Perception
likes.summary: Robbyant researchers introduced masked boundary modeling, a self-supervised pretraining method for Vision Transformers that explicitly targets fine-grained spatial structure. The approach enabled a 1.1B parameter model to achieve an RMSE of 0.296 on NYU-Depth v2, surpassing larger models like the 7B DINOv3, and demonstrated leading performance in video object segmentation and depth completion.

likes.summary: CompactionRL, a reinforcement learning framework developed by researchers at Tsinghua University and Z.AI, trains LLM agents to perform context compaction. likes.summary: A precise log-sigmoid scaling law governing the performance improvement of large language model agents from interaction in real-world environments was identified, exhibiting a mean R² of 0.998 on the new EdgeBench benchmark and revealing that frontier agent learning speed doubled every three months.

This framework improves compositional generalization and long-horizon execution on real-world and simulation benchmarks while maintaining real-time inference.

likes.title: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation
likes.summary: SenseTime Research presents a framework that unifies diverse computer vision tasks, spanning structured understanding, dense geometry, segmentation, and multi-view 3D, into a single multimodal generation paradigm. This approach enables a unified multimodal model to natively produce text, image, or mixed outputs for these tasks, achieving competitive performance across various benchmarks while retaining general multimodal abilities.

likes.summary: TREK (Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL) introduces a method to overcome the exploration bottleneck in on-policy reinforcement learning for large language models by employing distillation to expand the student model's sampling support toward novel, verified solution modes. This approach boosts performance on challenging mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, demonstrating gains of up to +14.2 percentage points and accelerating training efficiency.

likes.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
likes.summary: Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD), developed by researchers at Tsinghua University and ByteDance Seed, extracts and transfers the policy shift induced by reinforcement learning in a weak model as a dense, implicit reward signal to a stronger student. This method enables efficient weak-to-strong generalization for large language models, reducing post-training computational costs by approximately 50% and improving reasoning performance, for instance, by 10 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B on AIME 2024.

likes.title: MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution
likes.summary: MetaSkill-Evolve enables recursive self-improvement in LLM agents by allowing them to evolve not only their task-specific skills but also their underlying improvement procedures through a two-timescale evolutionary framework. This approach achieved held-out test accuracy improvements of +23.54 points on OfficeQA, +16.09 points on SealQA, and +1.92 points on ALFWorld over a raw Gemma-4 31B backbone.
